evidence: All five dimension prompts (gates/render, gates/constraints, scored/functional, scored/polish, scored/visual) and their judge.toml criteria describe HireOps only. (1) Residue scan: grep across tests/app_context.md, gates/*/*, scored/*/* for every sibling project name under projects/ (pellmoor, threadline, colderwater, torquebay, bazaarbridge, boardloom, docketlight, drawbill, expenseflow, gridforge, medcare, medledger, orbitalops, oriel, patchpad, ridgeline, utilibill, coursemark, common-ground, dropline, gambit, pixeldeck) plus CHANGE_ME/TODO/lorem/channel/ticket/invoice/patient/tenant/admin returned zero hits; template CHANGE_ME in app_context.md is fully replaced. (2) Credentials: app_context.md:8-19 lists password Hireops!2026 and the 10 accounts with roles exactly matching instruction.md:17 and seed users USR-REC1..3, USR-MGR1..3, USR-OBS1, USR-CAN1..3 (names, emails, roles). Every two-word proper name used in the prompts/criteria (Rafael Costa, Mei Lin, Farah Nasser, Ingrid Sorensen, Bill Okafor, Yuki Tanaka, Aud Halvorsen, Noor Haddad, Tomas Varga, Lena Fischer, Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi, Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz, Platform Engineer, Data Analyst, Product Designer) exists in seed_data.json. (3) Screens: app_context.md:23-25 Board (Applied, Screen, Interview, Offer, Hired, Rejected), Conversations, Activity, candidate applications matches instruction.md:11 and hireops_rules.md §3, §4, §6, §7; visual prompt.md:14 reviews exactly those surfaces. (4) Seeded facts the prompts assert re-derived from seed: three jobs; JOB-PLAT Applied = Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi and Screen = Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz by position (functional prompt.md:25, hro_restart judge.toml:407); Noor's APP-101 note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' (exact match); APP-101 has 120 messages (app_context.md:30); Lena APP-301 has 3 messages, Lena read_count 2, message 3 by USR-REC3 -> 1 unread (functional Z, hro_unread_counts); Tomas has seeded Data Analyst conversation APP-201 (functional T fallback); Bill is JOB-DATA manager but prompts use him as manager of review-created J2, which the prompt itself sets in S. (5) Rules stated in criteria match hireops_rules.md: candidate wording table (hro_candidate_view vs rules §7 and seed candidate_status_labels), 401 anonymous/403 role/404 candidate not-found (hro_anonymous, T, K vs rules §1), page size 30 (hro_thread_latest/earlier vs rules §6 and seed thread_page_size), hiring-manager late-stage scope and reopen limits (hro_mgr_* vs rules §3), Activity scope excluding notes (hro_activity vs rules §4), seen semantics excluding observer (hro_seen vs rules §6), interview places 1-50 integers (hro_job_open vs rules §2). (6) Deliverable: every prompt opens http://localhost:3000, consistent with app_context.md:4, instruction.md:13, integration.md and solution src/index.js:22. test.sh:198-200 substitutes app_context into all prompts, and each prompt carries {app_context} and {criteria}. Weak-app/alternative probe: a conforming app with different labels/routes is protected by app_context.md:33-34 and every prompt's 'Discover routes and controls by intent'; no prompt names a reference-implementation route, selector or field. Minor non-residue observation (Note-level, no score impact found): constraints gate judge.toml:23 and hro_job_open ask for a team, while the scored prompts' global gate (functional:11, polish:11, visual:11) and protocol S (functional:27) list title, hiring manager and places without naming team; the judge fills whatever the job form requires and hro_job_open itself names team, so this is not a description of a different app. Out-of-row observation for the owner (not graded here): polish leaves Rafael drafts in place (hro_pol_session_resume) and only the polish prompt tells the judge to clear pre-existing box text; the functional prompt has no equivalent if drafts are server-side and dimensions share state. This is a cross-dimension state question for other rows, not residue.
